final: WITH patient_measures AS (SELECT l.ID, p.SEX, AVG(l.ALB - l.TP) AS first_measure, AVG(l.APTT - l.PT) AS second_measure FROM Laboratory AS l JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = l.ID GROUP BY l.ID, p.SEX), sex_measures AS (SELECT SEX, AVG(first_measure) AS first_measure, AVG(second_measure) AS second_measure FROM patient_measures GROUP BY SEX), overall AS (SELECT AVG(second_measure) AS mean_second FROM sex_measures) SELECT AVG(s.first_measure), AVG(s.second_measure), AVG(s.second_measure - o.mean_second) FROM sex_measures AS s JOIN overall AS o ON o.mean_second IS NOT NULL WHERE s.second_measure > o.mean_second
